initial.title: [v0.92][WP-25] Internal review
initial.goal: Prepare and execute a findings-first internal review of the exact terminal v0.92 milestone candidate through nine independent specialist lanes.
initial.required_outcome: A digest-bound internal review packet, findings register, synthesis, validation record, and independent meta-review at one exact revision.
declared_scope: Canonical v0.92 code, docs, tests, lifecycle evidence, demos, launch assets, and release surfaces at one exact SHA
Nine independent specialist lanes and provenance-preserving synthesis
Packet validation, redaction audit, and independent review-quality meta-review
authority_boundary: Typed C-SDLC v2 records remain lifecycle authority
WP-25 records findings but does not remediate, approve external review, or authorize release
operator_constraints: Prepare before dependencies close but do not bind or execute early
Use the new agent-logic repository for issue and PR identity
Preserve reviewer-authored findings, duplicates, disagreements, and limitations
Do not expose credentials, raw private state, provider prompts, or host-absolute paths
initial.task_boundary: Prepare the complete internal-review contract now without starting the issue; execute later only after WP-23 and WP-24 are terminal, reconciled, ancestral, and clean, with WP-24A truthfully deferred to v0.92.1.
deliverables: Internal review report and stable findings register
Exact-SHA review packet and machine-readable digest manifest
Nine specialist lane results with reviewer identity and completion truth
Findings-first synthesis preserving duplicates and disagreements
Validation, redaction, and independent meta-review records
acceptance_criteria: WP-23 #312 and WP-24 #10 are terminal, reconciled, ancestral, and cleaned before review execution; WP-24A is recorded as deferred to v0.92.1 and non-blocking
The packet pins agent-logic/agent-design-language and one clean exact target SHA
Included, excluded, unknown, local-only, generated, vendored, private, and redacted surfaces are explicitly inventoried
All nine independent specialist lanes record reviewer identity, scope, method, evidence, limitations, and findings or a defensible zero-finding result
Every finding has stable ID, severity, exact evidence, invariant or failure mode, reproduction or proof gap, owner route, duplicate links, disagreement state, and open disposition
Synthesis preserves source provenance, duplicates, disagreements, and residual risks without remediation
Packet identity, manifest digests, evidence links, lane completion, finding schema, redaction, and private-path hygiene validate fail-closed
An independent meta-review reports no actionable review-quality gap
The result makes no remediation, external-approval, release-readiness, publication, or deployment claim
dependencies: Canonical WP-23 issue #312 terminal, reconciled, ancestral, and clean
Canonical WP-24 issue #10 terminal, reconciled, ancestral, and clean
Operator disposition deferring WP-24A to v0.92.1, reconciled into #313 and its cards before issue start
Sprint 6 umbrella #307 graph reconciled with the canonical dependency identities
non_goals: Approving release, deployment, publication, or submission
Creating one issue per finding without a separate routing decision
Crediting predecessor artifacts as acceptance without exact-revision proof
initial.plan_summary: Verify terminal entry gates, freeze one clean exact SHA, build the review packet, run nine independent specialist lanes, synthesize findings without remediation, validate identity/digests/redaction, and obtain independent meta-review before handoff.

steps.action: Reconcile canonical dependency, issue, PR, lifecycle, ancestry, worktree, and candidate-SHA truth.
Build the exact-SHA packet manifest and explicit included, excluded, unknown, private, generated, and redacted scope inventory.
Run all nine independent specialist lanes against the identical packet and exact SHA.
Create the provenance-preserving findings register and findings-first synthesis without remediation.
Run packet schema, identity, digest, link, redaction, path-hygiene, and negative validation.
Obtain independent meta-review, correct actionable packet-quality findings, and retain the bounded WP-26 handoff disposition.

invariants: Every lane reviews the same repository, manifest, and exact SHA
A source or manifest change makes all dependent review evidence stale
Missing evidence, lane identity, or dependency truth blocks review
Synthesis cannot erase finding provenance, duplicates, or disagreement
WP-25 never converts review evidence into remediation or release authority
risks: Typed initialization could regress the already-correct #313 WP-24A deferral unless live issue truth is preserved
Large scope can produce superficial lanes unless evidence denominators are explicit
Self-referential packet commits can stale exact-head claims
Historical evidence may contain host-local paths or private data requiring careful boundary treatment
stop_conditions: Any active v0.92 dependency is nonterminal, noncanonical, nonancestral, or has active worktree topology at execution time
The candidate checkout is dirty or the target SHA changes after packet generation
Any specialist lane is missing, incomplete, stale, or lacks reviewer identity
Manifest digest, evidence link, finding schema, redaction, or private-path validation fails
Independent meta-review reports an unresolved actionable quality gap

validation_lanes.proof_role: Validate exact repository and SHA identity, dependency gates, nine lane completions, finding schema, digests, links, redaction, and claim boundaries.
validation_lanes.defer_reason: The issue-owned validator is an execution deliverable and runs only after the exact target SHA and review packet exist.

validation_lanes.proof_role: Validate the retained independent meta-review identity, exact packet and target digests, coverage and severity evaluation, limitations, and zero unresolved actionable review-quality findings.
validation_lanes.defer_reason: Runs only after an independent reviewer has produced the retained meta-review; the validator does not author or approve that review.

validation_lanes.proof_role: Reject whitespace and patch hygiene errors in the review packet, validator, and milestone entrypoint.

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed before review authority on dependency drift, wrong repository or SHA, incomplete lane coverage, invalid finding provenance, digest mismatch, evidence-link failure, private-data leakage, or unresolved meta-review findings.
review_prompts: Does the entry gate prove every predecessor is canonical, terminal, ancestral, and cleaned rather than merely closed?
Do all nine lanes share one exact packet and SHA with independent reviewer identity?
Can any zero-finding lane pass without an evidence-backed denominator and stated limitations?
Does synthesis preserve every duplicate, disagreement, severity rationale, and original reviewer claim?
Can any artifact leak secrets, private state, raw prompts, or host-absolute paths?
Does any wording overclaim remediation, external approval, or release readiness?
initial.review_scope: The complete v0.92 internal-review packet contract, all nine specialist outputs, findings register, synthesis, validator evidence, redaction boundary, and independent meta-review at the frozen exact SHA.
